from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0016.png"))
# Cabinet in 16:
# Brown side panel is on the right of the white cabinet:
# The cabinet is visible on the left side: xs from 0 to 195
# Let us inspect the bottom contact of the cabinet in 16:

print(f"Cabinet panel in 16: xs=[{xs_c.min()}, {xs_c.max()}], ys=[{ys_c.min()}, {ys_c.max()}]")

# Let us find the bottom of the cabinet in 16:
# Sample col 150
for y in range(350, 410, 5):
    print(f"y={y}: RGB at x=150: {img[y, 150]}")
'
